en.headline: AFCD detains eight unattended dogs after Yuen Long joint operation
en.dek: The five-day sweep with police followed a fatal dog attack last week. Three dogs were microchipped and one owner faces prosecution; a staff member was bitten but is stable.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said on Thursday evening that it had detained eight unattended dogs during a five-day joint operation with police in the Yuen Long area, launched after a 27-year-old woman died in a suspected dog attack the previous weekend.

The dogs are being held at an AFCD animal management centre for observation. Three of them were found to be microchipped. The department has begun prosecuting one registered owner for alleged breaches of the Rabies Regulation and the Rabies Ordinance, including failure to hold a valid dog licence and failure to keep proper control of a dog in a public place.
During the operation one dog bit a frontline staff member on the hand. The worker received treatment, remains in stable condition and is under observation in hospital.

The AFCD dismissed claims that the dogs would be euthanised after four days. It said the four-day period is the statutory window for inquiries and owner tracing. Unclaimed animals that are healthy and docile will be neutered through animal welfare organisations and made available for public adoption. Unclaimed dogs will not be released back into the community, the department said, in order to protect public safety.

zh.headline: 漁護署元朗聯合捕狗行動結束 共扣留八隻無人看管狗隻
zh.dek: 行動為期五日，因應上周一名女子疑遭狗隻襲擊身亡而展開。三隻狗隻有晶片，一名畜養人被檢控；一名前線人員被咬傷，情況穩定。
body: 漁農自然護理署周四晚表示，與警方在元朗一帶進行為期五日的聯合行動後，共扣留八隻無人看管的狗隻。行動因應上周一名27歲女子疑遭狗隻襲擊身亡而展開。
所有狗隻現正於漁護署動物管理中心扣留及觀察。當中三隻植入晶片。署方已就其中一隻狗隻的登記畜養人提出檢控，指其涉嫌違反《狂犬病規例》未有領有有效狗牌，以及《狂犬病條例》在公眾地方未有妥善控制狗隻。
行動期間，一隻狗隻咬傷一名前線人員的手部。該名人員經治療後情況穩定，現正留院觀察。
漁護署澄清，並非在捕獲四日後即人道毀滅狗隻。四日只是法例規定追查畜養人的時限。若無人認領，署方會耐心觀察，將健康溫馴的狗隻交由動物福利機構絕育後供公眾領養。署方強調，無人認領的狗隻不會放回社區，以保障公眾安全。
